summary: As a society we decide how to fuel the economy. The Trump tax cuts mean billionaires now pay less in taxes than middle class. The thinking is the money grows the economy... But it doesn't. Anyone feel richer with Market at 30k?
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
As a society we decide how to fuel the economy. The Trump tax cuts mean billionaires now pay less in taxes than middle class.

The thinking is the money grows the economy... But it doesn't. Anyone feel richer with Market at 30k?
